chunks: And ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a fasting person extracting his molar, he said: “No, and he should not make his mouth bleed.”

key_terms.لَا: no; indicating prohibition or disallowance here

ai.seo_question: Can a fasting person have a tooth extracted while fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a fasting person who wishes to extract a tooth. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام forbids it in a manner connected with causing the mouth to bleed, indicating caution regarding actions during fasting that involve blood in the mouth.
